      "kind": "correctness",

        "c:4765439854",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "use util::Expected to distinguish validation success and failure at the type level",
      "quote": "I'd push this one step further and use `util::Expected` here, it's a natural fit and follows the PR's own motivation.",

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer clarified this is not a blocker and later opened RFC #35646",

      "status_by_quote": "my concerns should not be a blocker"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "split out the FlushStateToDisk behavior change into a separate PR to keep this PR strictly a refactoring",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author split out behavior change into PR #35621",

      "status_by_id": "c:4837427337",

      "kind": "correctness",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3526455779",
      "status_by_quote": "However, here ConnectBlock still return both bool and state, so the check makes sense. I've put it back in the else branch."
    },

      "status_by_id": "rc:4073148752",

        "c:5778734891"

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5778734891",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, the idea can be applied on those equally, I have left them out (or for later?) to limit the scope."
